slides.core_question: What engineering problem does this project solve, and what is the method's real focus?
slides.single_takeaway: DOEF treats load forecasting as an input to battery peak-shaving decisions, not as the endpoint.
slides.headline: DOEF：让负荷预测服务于储能削峰决策
supporting_copy: Suggested subtitle: 面向储能决策的集成负荷预测方法。
Working title only; retain the verified official project title when it becomes available.
slides.speaker_intent: Position the entry as an AI-plus-energy decision problem and prevent LightGBM from becoming the perceived innovation.
slides.transition_from: Opening of the defense.
slides.transition_to: If prediction serves a decision, the first question is whether the usual prediction metric identifies the best decision.
must_not_claim: This is the verified official competition project title.
LightGBM itself is the project innovation.
The project proves cost, carbon, or energy savings.
design_notes_for_next_phase: Minimal title slide; no scientific chart.

slides.core_question: Why is forecast accuracy alone insufficient for this project?
slides.single_takeaway: In the frozen eight-building aggregate, slightly lower forecast RMSE did not correspond to lower battery decision regret.
slides.headline: 更低的预测 RMSE，并未带来更低的储能决策 regret
supporting_copy: XGBoost and LightGBM reverse order between normalized RMSE and normalized decision regret.
This is a project-scoped counterexample, not a claim that forecast accuracy is irrelevant.
slides.speaker_intent: Create the central tension with one frozen comparison before introducing the method.
slides.transition_from: The project is judged by the decision it supports.
slides.transition_to: To understand the reversal, show where forecasting sits in the engineering chain.
must_not_claim: Forecast accuracy is irrelevant.
All more accurate forecasts lead to worse decisions.
The small directional difference proves a universal causal mechanism.
design_notes_for_next_phase: Use SCI-01 unchanged as the dominant visual.
Do not add a second chart or full benchmark table.

slides.core_question: How does a forecast affect the final peak-shaving outcome?
slides.single_takeaway: Prediction is an intermediate signal: it shapes a battery schedule that is ultimately evaluated on realized load.
slides.headline: 预测只是中间环节，调度结果才是工程终点
supporting_copy: Historical load → day-ahead forecast → constrained battery dispatch → realized post-storage peak.
Every forecast method is compared under the same frozen battery constraints.

primary_metric_or_fact.display: Same frozen battery constraints for all forecast methods

slides.speaker_intent: Give mixed AI and engineering judges a shared mental model without opening the optimizer details.
slides.transition_from: The metric reversal exists because forecasts are consumed by a downstream process.
slides.transition_to: That process exposes the limitation of selecting models only by forecast error.
must_not_claim: The conceptual diagram is new experimental evidence.
The battery controller is already deployed in real buildings.
Peak shaving equals energy, cost, or carbon savings.
design_notes_for_next_phase: Use CON-01 as conceptual/explanatory, visibly distinct from scientific result figures.
Keep optimizer constraints verbal; details belong in appendix.

slides.slide_role: Forecast-only selection limitation and DOEF introduction
slides.core_question: What changes when selection follows the downstream objective?
slides.single_takeaway: DOEF keeps forecasting components fixed but changes the selection criterion from forecast error alone to Validation battery regret.
slides.headline: 模型不只要预测得准，还要在 Validation 上支持更好的储能决策
supporting_copy: Traditional: forecast → forecast metric → select.
DOEF: forecast → dispatch → decision regret → freeze ensemble weight.

primary_metric_or_fact.display: Selection objective changes; the frozen component forecasts do not

slides.speaker_intent: Introduce the methodological response as a selection-framework change rather than a new base learner.
slides.transition_from: Forecast error and decision regret answer different questions.
slides.transition_to: Now show the complete frozen DOEF process and its information boundaries.
must_not_claim: DOEF jointly trains the predictor and optimizer.
DOEF is a new LightGBM model.
Decision regret replaces all forecast-quality checks.
design_notes_for_next_phase: Use a simple two-row native process comparison; no new data graphic.
Make the changed selection criterion the only emphasized difference.

slides.core_question: What exactly is the frozen DOEF algorithm and where are choices made?
slides.single_takeaway: DOEF freezes each building's DayWeek–LightGBM weight on Validation decision regret, then evaluates the unchanged pipeline on Test.
slides.headline: DOEF 在 Validation 上按决策 regret 冻结权重，再进入 Test
supporting_copy: Causal DayWeek and LightGBM forecasts → candidate weights → Validation dispatch evaluation → frozen per-building weight → Test evaluation.
Test has no feedback path to model, weight, tie-break, or battery configuration.
slides.speaker_intent: Explain the algorithm once, visually, with the selection/evaluation boundary impossible to miss.
slides.transition_from: The selection criterion changes from forecast-only to downstream decision value.
slides.transition_to: With the method fixed, the next question is whether the frozen Test results improve the relevant outcomes.
must_not_claim: The method is end-to-end differentiable, bilevel, online, or reinforcement learning.
Oracle is deployable.
Test selected or adjusted the weights.
design_notes_for_next_phase: Use ARCH-01 unchanged as the dominant method visual.
Do not add feature lists, parameter tables, or optimizer equations.

slides.core_question: Did the frozen DOEF pipeline improve the forecast and downstream decision aggregates?
slides.single_takeaway: Against LightGBM on the frozen eight-building Test aggregate, DOEF improved both normalized MAE and normalized decision regret.
slides.headline: DOEF 同时降低预测误差与储能决策 regret
supporting_copy: Report the aggregate improvements beside the building win/tie/loss result.
Keep the disclosed negative peak-reduction building visible; do not convert regret into money.

primary_metric_or_fact.display: Normalized MAE relative improvement vs LightGBM: 6.3585%
Normalized decision-regret relative improvement vs LightGBM: 3.6147%

slides.speaker_intent: Land the strongest approved result without turning the slide into a metrics table.
slides.transition_from: The algorithm and evaluation boundary are now fixed.
slides.transition_to: The result makes sense only if the audience understands what the two metrics do—and do not—measure.
must_not_claim: DOEF is universally superior or state of the art.
The result covers unseen buildings or more than one fixed Test month per building.

Every building has positive peak reduction.
design_notes_for_next_phase: Use SCI-02 unchanged; no full benchmark table.
The negative minimum is a caveat, not a competing headline.

slides.core_question: Why can forecast and decision metrics rank methods differently?
slides.single_takeaway: RMSE summarizes forecast error magnitude, while decision regret evaluates the realized peak after that forecast drives constrained dispatch.
slides.headline: RMSE 衡量预测误差；regret 衡量误差经过调度后的工程后果
supporting_copy: The metrics answer different questions and therefore need not induce the same ranking.
The frozen evidence shows an observed mismatch; it does not prove a universal error-location mechanism.

primary_metric_or_fact.display: Normalized decision regret is realized post-dispatch peak regret versus a non-deployable Oracle

slides.speaker_intent: Resolve the hook conceptually while staying within observed and metric-definition evidence.
slides.transition_from: DOEF improved both aggregates, but the original mismatch still needs interpretation.
slides.transition_to: Next, test whether the decision result is confined to one building or persists across the fixed benchmark.
must_not_claim: Where an error occurs has been causally proven to determine regret in all cases.
Forecast magnitude metrics have no value.
The optimizer eliminates forecast error.
design_notes_for_next_phase: Use a text-led metric-to-question comparison, not another result chart.
This slide may be compressed verbally if time is tight, but its distinction must remain.

slides.core_question: Is the decision result limited to a single favorable building?

supporting_copy: Buildings were fixed through frozen eligibility rules and Train-only morphology before Validation/Test performance was evaluated.
This supports multi-building robustness within the fixed scope, not unseen-building transfer.
